futureProcess: Freeze each identity-bearing milestone with current source/export hashes and a native-size matrix covering the universal day avatar, owned night variant, header, wordmark and character-in-content on intended surrounds. Each reviewer inspects actual rendered images before reading their partner's new score.
Use emil-design-eng's Before/After/Why table to connect a specific visible problem, its proposed remedy and the observed result. Reject decorative changes without a demonstrated purpose.

Carry the apple-design typography principle as a practical320px/390px/desktop wrap and hierarchy pass. Check font size, weight, leading and tracking together, and label enlarged-text coverage separately when performed. Preserve the established Schibsted type and outlined wordmark unless a demonstrated defect requires change.

Use mobile-native to inspect capability-gated hover, coarse-pointer field text, zoom and document scrolling. Engineering owns platform behavior checks; identity owns scale/framing/hierarchy. Browser-width evidence, real-phone evidence and AT evidence remain separate fields.

When night reduction is revisited, compare circular-masked variants at actual supported sizes on realistic intended surrounds with the adopted asset as control. Try supported size or placement first; paint changes need a visible gain, and anatomy inflation is not an accepted remedy.

Keep static craft, continuous-motion perception, measured runtime cadence and unfamiliar-human recognition/recall as distinct outcomes. A checklist pass or team agreement never substitutes for missing audience or physical-device evidence.
exceptions: UI timing ceilings and high-frequency keyboard guidance do not truncate the requested character acting.
GPU advice does not authorize deleting tiny anatomy or face details; profile an actual bottleneck before changing the rig.
Apple typography principles do not imply Apple materials, translucent chrome or replacing the established brand typeface.
A scrolling study does not automatically need an app shell, overscroll suppression, global selection removal or unrelated libraries.
Reading the17-entry catalog is not an invocation of every opt-in skill or authorization for source edits during an independent review.
